# Index

## Description

Issue templates. GitHub offers these templates when a reader opens a new issue, so
maintainers receive the details they need to assess the report or request.

## Files

- [README.md](README.md) — Describes this folder and lists its files.
- [`bug_report.md`](bug_report.md) — Collects reproduction steps, expected and actual behaviour, and the reporter's environment.
- [`feature_request.md`](feature_request.md) — Collects the problem, the proposed solution, alternatives, and the expected result.
